items.title: 67259_Big Chief Moore oral history interview
items.q: I got to play the Central Plaza with quite a number of other people like Willie "the Lion" (Smith) and Red Allen

ctx.x: Now, with Bechet, now, you were with him two different times it seems -- 1947 after the Armstrong band broke up until 1949 and then back again in 1951 or were you straight through with him from about '47 to '51, and where did you tour with Bechet?

Well, during that time, I was on and off with Bechet different times on 52nd Street and then when he would leave the place, he'd rather go by himself to Europe or to another location. He didn't take me along because I had something else to do and in that way I got to play the Central Plaza with quite a number of other people like Willie "the Lion" (Smith) and Red Allen and Buster Bailey and Fletcher Henderson and Max Kaminsky and Bill Davison, Pete Johnson, and a lot of the guys, Tony Parenti was there and Conrad…
